heading: Contact & opportunities
body: I welcome inquiries from prospective students, postdoctoral researchers, and potential collaborators interested in aquatic ecology, food webs, biodiversity, and environmental change.

graduate.heading: Graduate students
paragraphs: Prospective graduate students can apply to LSU’s Biological Sciences graduate program through the LSU Graduate School. For details about the program, visit the Biological Sciences Graduate Program.

I am currently considering prospective Ph.D. students. If you are interested in joining my lab, please complete the online questionnaire and upload your CV or résumé through the form. You are also welcome to email me with questions.

postdoc.heading: Postdoctoral positions
paragraphs: I welcome inquiries from prospective postdoctoral fellows interested in trophic ecology, ecosystem functioning, and spider and insect ecology, including research that connects these areas to broader ecological questions.
requirements: A cover letter summarizing your major research accomplishments and future research interests
postdoc.note: Opportunities depend on available funding and project fit.

undergraduate.heading: Undergraduate students
undergraduate.description: Undergraduate students interested in gaining research experience in the lab are encouraged to complete the online questionnaire and upload a CV or résumé through the form. You are also welcome to email me with questions.

collaborations.heading: Research collaborations
paragraphs: I enjoy working with researchers across disciplines and welcome opportunities to collaborate on questions related to aquatic and terrestrial ecosystems, trophic ecology, biodiversity, contaminants, and ecological modeling.
If you have an idea for a collaboration, please send me a brief description of your project or question. I would be happy to discuss areas of shared interest.
